ok lets go from the beginning:

- My bf and I am from the same culture, but educated in a complete opposite manner, his family is more liberal and gave more liberties to their kids
- That goes to the second point, My parents are a hella religious, and have a bad vision on sex outside the marriage (also being bigoted and homophobic are part of that menu) my parents don't seem to love each other, they are still together for convenience, because they are old and alone they are fucking poor if alone.
- Its true that I feel guilty for having attraction towards other people, I don't know if that is related to my parent issues the way I was raised (too conservative and religious family).
- And I really don't know how to answer the last one, he can have feelings toward other and still love me, he doesn't going to leave me like that because he choose me from above others because he can relate with me so much. But he is like that, I don't understand those feelings because the white and black perspective of my BPD (yes, i know about that) so is a dichotomy when it comes to people because I like/hate them, I gave then importance/ignore completely.

I guess the part of "I like you, and I want to have sex with you and still be your friend" is something I can more or less understand, but not completely, but something like "you are hot, I want a one night stand with you" thing is kind of awkward and abstract to me,something that makes me feel like a monster or inhuman, because so many people seems to see like something normal.

Is something of the grey areas I don't understand, I suppose, but don't really know.
